notes.title: Keepers of the Keep: DEMO OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[h1]《KEEPERS of the KEEP》[/h1]
[h3]DEMO RELEASES TODAY![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494370/8e381e22bcfa7dab9e65d95e31b4a079c6798632.png[/img]

Hey y'all!

For those of you who have been curious about Keepers of the Keep, I'm so happy to announce that the game's demo is now available for everyone to play!🎉✨ Play through 6 quests, manage your stats, work your day job, and much more! 

The demo will receive regular updates to fix any errors that may occur along the way, and may even pick up some new features as the full game is being developed. So, if you want to get familiar with Keepers of the Keep and how the game works, now is the time to start practicing your dice rolls! Happy demo launch day, y'all!

- KINJA

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421050/Keepers_of_the_Keep/
